title: Flat cohomology comparison on compact separated schemes
statement: Let R,S be commutative rings, S a flat R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], X a compact scheme with f:X→Spec R separated [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], M a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent], and q≥0. Form X_S and p^*M by [def-pc-base-change], and use Ext-based cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology] with the scalar actions from f and f_S. Then the specific S-linear comparison β^q_{f,M,S}:S⊗_R HOver(f,M,q)→HOver(f_S,p^*M,q) of [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] is bijective. S is not required to be a field, M is not required to have finite-dimensional cohomology, and X is not required to be proper.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.5.2 (Tag 02KH), proof, separated-case paragraph: finite affine cover, affine sections, and exact tensor on Cech cohomology

proof.text: Choose the finite subcover of the affine cover using compactness. Its open ranges are affine and their supremum is top. Apply [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] to obtain c with its canonical formula and IsIso c.
Apply [lem-pc-flat-cech-cohomology-square] to c and its coordinate formula, obtaining the two Leray isomorphisms and equality of their composite with ModuleCat.ofHom(beta).

The middle exact-tensor homology isomorphism is constructed from Mathlib ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso by flatness; it requires only the three adjacent degrees. Since c is an isomorphism, homologyMap c is an isomorphism. Extension of a Leray isomorphism is also an isomorphism. Rewrite by the commuting-square equality to conclude IsIso(ModuleCat.ofHom(beta)), and use ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective.
